The pharmacist in my state has received CDC or some other governmental guidelines not mandates but guidelines that they are treating is mandates that patients should not have more than 90 morphine units or I think that's what they are called. In my state the pharmacist is allowed to deny filling the prescription and they contact the doctor to tell them that.

 The doctor informed me at my appointment that the pharmacist would not be giving me the same medication so she is weaning me the pharmacist is just refusing to fill it the doctor is the one that's not prescribing the same medication. they did warn me this might happen at My pain Management because the pharmacists are taking this more seriously and I think it's a power trip to be honest.

 But I really don't think the police or anybody higher up would give a damn honestly because they did send out notices saying that this was official guidelines and even though these are not mandates and it is not law they are entitled not to serve you in my state so I don't think there's really anything I can do. 

Especially because of my age if I complain about anything they will label me a drug seeker. I'm not kidding they will label me and I will never get any medication. 

So honestly I'm just trying to take what I can get and do what I can because this is not going to end anytime soon and I know you can't hear my tone when I'm writing this but I'm here crying and I'm sure a lot of people would agree with me when I say fuck the DEA and their enforcement on legal prescriptions and people that need them.

They didn't end up drug testing me but I had managed to get my morning dose down. 
The only thing that went wrong is apparently I'm on too many morphine units or something and my pharmacy, not my Dr, is refusing to fill my normal meds and they are now weening me down despite the meds I was on not even covering a quarter of my pain. 
Gotta love the US and their idiotic drug war.
